Radio: NASA

Edited Apollo 11 radio recordings courtesy of NASA. Manual attitude control is good. Roger, copy. Altitude 4,200. Houston, you are go for landing, over. Roger. Understand. Go for landing. 3,000 feet. Eagle, looking great. You're go. Altitude 1,600. 1,400 feet, still looking very good. Thirty feet, two and a half down. Four forward. Drifting to the right a little. Twenty feet, down a half. Thirty seconds. Drifting forward just a little bit, that's good. Contact light. Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed. Roger, Tranquility, we copy you on the ground. You got a bunch of guys about to turn blue. We're breathing again. Thanks a lot. At the ending dialog: That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.
